fields.subject: DataConnectionConfigurationBase
fields.condition: a connection has a RetryInterval and a RetryLengthening strategy
fields.trigger: a caller requests the retry delay for attempt n
fields.response: return n times the interval for Linear, floor(n squared divided by 2) times the interval for HalfSquare, 2 to the power n minus 1 times the interval for Squaring, and (2n minus 1) times the interval for the default strategy
